name: ripple
description: The viewer's ripple, as on the blog: click the scan and a wave runs inward over 3 seconds, its size scaled by the hit point's distance to the camera; splats move along the direction from the hit point and brighten on the crests (at 0.3 of the viewer's amplitude, which is a lot on an object).

source.name: World Labs threeviewer effects (ripple.glsl; blog: rippleEffect(time, 3.0, outward false, hit, distance to camera)), blog demo parameters

reach.note: Scale: the hit point's distance to the camera
